question: What dark coloration is accessed by resorting to the place of the yogini?
premises: The practitioner resorts to the place of the yogini
A specific coloration is encountered there
That coloration is dark and black
inference: By resorting to the place of the yogini, one accesses a dark, black coloration.
plain_english: Having resorted to the place of the yogini, one encounters the dark, black color.
